texts: good. it follows the negated-indefinite template exactly — the wraith's typing and the person's typing both stay inside the one strength-0 bundle, so nothing is asserted to exist or to have happened.

good. the indefinite subject stays a specific witness rather than becoming a generic, "lit" stays an adjective instead of being read as a verb, and the drained essence and the "from" phrase both land on the licensed roles.
good. "drained" stays an adjectival participle, "dimly" keeps its surface form as the manner adverb, and the undergoing intransitive subject takes the right role.

good. the whenever-clause becomes a fireable rule — plain-variable premises, a wraith and a rising minted per occurrence and linked back to the trigger — with "at the Sunken Cove" and "before dawn" both landing on licensed heads, and "the cove's water" staying on the possessive route rather than the containment one.

good. the capitalized plural label is treated as a name, stative "know" with an entity object gets the perception-state roles, and the continuative perfect comes through as an ongoing state with an at-least-two-generations duration bound.

good. "the Stilllight Lantern" takes the multi-word-name treatment while "the Council" correctly stays an unnamed common noun, and "strict" survives inside the fused kind strict_standard, which carries its own genus atoms. Fusing a plain descriptive adjective is a borderline call — a bare-plural kind-level object leaves no witness to hang it on otherwise — but no content is lost either way.
